title: KABA x PhilCAS TINIKLING WORKSHOP
description: A little throwback to our Tinikling Workshop in collaboration with PhilCAS of BC! 🎋🇵🇭 Thank you to everyone who joined us to learn, dance, and experience a piece of Filipino culture together. And a special thank you to PhilCAS of BC for sharing their knowledge and guiding us through the workshop! 🫶
